messages:
Maya (CS): Heads-up: Pegasus Data wants a short POC tomorrow — EU + South Africa split, temporary per-route QPS bump to 35 for 36h, and three CIDRs for peering. Also asked about audit logs and a renewal concern unless we show cost controls.
Ethan (Solutions Eng): Got CIDRs? Also they mentioned possible KMS for Private later.
Maya (CS): Provided CIDRs: 41.79.0.0/16, 197.210.0.0/16, 3.120.45.0/24. Start 2025-07-02 08:00 UTC, 36h.
Sam (Support Ops): I'll open infra ticket and request temp policy `pegasus-poc-split`. Tagging infra-bot to confirm capacity.
infra-bot: Quick check: eu-west-1 headroom ~10%. We can support +35 QPS if we reserve 3 GPUs for window. Recommend reservation.
Sam (Support Ops): Reserving now and adding auto-fallback to lower-concurrency variant. Also adding `enable_detailed_logs: true` param and S3 delivery option — need S3 bucket ARN and IAM role from customer.
Maya (CS): I'll get S3 details and schedule pricing call with AE for 07:30 UTC before start. They want per-route cost estimates and KV warmup advice.
Ethan (Solutions Eng): Paste for infra ticket:
``npolicy: pegasus-poc-split
rules:
  - region: eu
    route: eu-edge-v2
    qps_limit: 35
  - region: af-south
    route: af-edge-canary
    qps_limit: 35
whitelist:
  - 41.79.0.0/16
  - 197.210.0.0/16
  - 3.120.45.0/24
window: 36h
auto-revoke: true
```
Sam (Support Ops): Infra ticket #4478 created. ETA ~3 hrs for whitelist + logs. Will DM when ready.
Maya (CS): Logging feedback: they want clearer console projections per-route + caching impact. Filed FEAT-1241.
security-bot: KMS onboarding requires MSA + key policy. Logged to security queue.
Maya (CS): Will capture renewal concerns in CS notes and include cost-control options in the prep doc.
Sam (Support Ops): Done reservation. Kicking KV warmup once infra confirms.
summary: Pegasus Data POC coordination: EU+SA split routing, temp QPS bump, CIDR peering whitelist, audit logs to S3, KMS onboarding note, and renewal risk mitigation
